description.value: New Fuji is a Japanese restaurant located on West 1st Avenue in Vancouver, near the False Creek seawall — a popular cycling corridor. It is part of a larger Vancouver-area restaurant group that includes Kingyo, Rajio Raisu, Toyokan, and several other Japanese concepts. Diners can reserve a table, order pickup, or arrange delivery.
